hazards.evidence: A white raised toilet seat sits on a white toilet, set against a white bathtub and light beige floor. The low contrast makes the seat hard for a person with dementia to see and judge when sitting down. Only the gray frame handles stand out.

A black rectangular mat lies on light beige tile in front of the toilet and tub. A person with dementia may see it as a hole or a step, which can cause hesitation, stepping around it, or a fall in a key transfer area.
